observations.behavior: Adds a CLI command and its tests for a short-lived AI gateway token, including a browser approval flow.
observations.posthog_connection: This CLI command, when executed, would call a PostHog API endpoint to exchange an approved browser code and verifier for a token. The backend implementation and API endpoint are not supplied, so the actual PostHog connection and its security properties cannot be assessed.
